_comment: Retrieval eval set. One JSON object per line. `expectedWorks` accepts a work id or a title; `expectedLocators` matches any chunk whose range contains the locator, so the set survives re-ingestion and re-chunking. Questions with no expectations are out-of-library or metadata controls: they are answered in full and marked on whether the library refused. Run with `make eval`. Recall@10 and MRR are recorded before and after every change to chunking, fusion weights, or the reranker - retrieval tuned by vibes regresses silently.
